Watch: Keep an eye on bond market stability; continued signs of the sell-off ending would be a tailwind for your tech positions. Also, monitor METU, which has a scanner "ACCUMULATE" setup.

plays: Re-evaluate SOXL and SPAL. Given deep losses, "SELL" status, and leveraged nature on margin, consider trimming or exiting to manage risk.
Consider adding to your METU position. The scanner shows an "ACCUMULATE" setup with an entry range of 30.63-30.6 and a stop at 30.47.
